title: ConfidenceReport
description: Artifact produced by phase-4d-confidence-scoring (TASK-0079). Section-level confidence scores computed deterministically from review findings. Feeds into phase-4e debate trigger and phase-4h validation.

report_id.description: Unique report ID. Format: CONF-{YYYY}-{first 8 hex chars of SHA-256 of plan_id}.

plan_confidence.description: Overall plan confidence. Computed as min(section.confidence) over all NON-outlier sections (sections with confidence >= confidence_floor). If all sections are outliers, plan_confidence = confidence_floor.

confidence_floor.description: Configurable floor. Sections with confidence < confidence_floor are excluded from the min() computation as outliers. Default 0.3. Set via pipeline_config.confidence_floor.

outlier_sections.description: section_ids excluded from plan_confidence computation because their confidence < confidence_floor.

debate_trigger_sections.description: section_ids whose confidence < 0.5. These are flagged for phase-4e debate consideration, independent of the contradiction check.

validation_block_sections.description: section_ids whose confidence = 0.0 (maximum penalties applied). These always trigger hard check HC-07 failure in phase-4h.

penalty_table.description: The penalty weights used during this computation run. Recorded for auditability.

penalties_applied.description: Each finding that contributed a penalty to this section.

total_penalty.description: Sum of all individual penalties. May exceed 1.0; confidence is clamped to max(0.0, 1.0 - total_penalty).

finding_ids.description: finding_ids (RVW-...) from the review_report that affect this section.

is_outlier.description: True when confidence < confidence_floor. Outlier sections are excluded from plan_confidence min() computation.

penalty.description: Penalty value applied for this finding: critical=0.30, high=0.15, medium=0.05, low=0.02, info=0.00.

critical.description: Penalty for critical findings. Default 0.30. Configurable via pipeline_config.plan_debate_penalty_critical.
